speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sarcoidosis. The combination of a chronic pruritic rash on the upper body and face with symmetric sensory neuropathy (numbness/tingling) in the palms is highly suggestive of systemic sarcoidosis, particularly given the patient's age and potential environmental exposures. I will await the results of the ANA, RF, ACE levels (if not included in the initial panel), and the chest imaging to confirm hilar adenopathy or granulomas before finalizing the treatment plan.
